reviews.text: Lovely location and people that care.
Lovely people very accommodating to our needs. Looked after my Poppy very well and trained her well.
Great place Betty loves her visits here

I had my dog bob stay here for 6 nights. When arriving the lady was reluctant to show me where he sleeps.
I demanded to see. Walking through the kennels it absolutely stunk! All the dogs had wee and poo in the kennels.
After seeing how she was with bob, just trying to tease him in with a treat, locked and away.  It was fully clear there is no care or love!
After seeing this I said no, I am not leaving my dog here, we are going.
She managed to talk me round into leaving him and assured he would be looked after.
The kennels are disgusting, I wish I got photos!

I asked for photos of him while I was away to see him playing and out in the fields. The send me a photo of him in the little compound area. No photos of him being walked.

On leaving I said I would be landing around 6:30pm and I would collect him around 8/9pm. Which was then fine. The day before I messaged just to confirm my arrival. She said no, pickup times and between 10-11am.
Or she would charge me £50, to step out her back door and let me collect my dog.

After collecting bob, he was so skinny!! He had lost so much weight! His fur was looking so un healthy, and full of dandruff! He was clearly not happy!
I understand our dogs miss home, but this looked like pure neglect! Lack of exercise and love!!
I do not believe for 1 second they exercise the dogs like they say they do.
Otherwise she would have sent me a photo while he was out on a walk!!

Attached photos, the first photo is bob looking healthy, the rest are after 6 days of Hartley woods!!

There are many other places we can take our dogs where they truly get a bit of care. Avoid this dirty old place, the lady does not care about our pets!

Always a friendly reception when picking up and dropping off. The cats are kept in very clean, spacious enclosures with multi levels and things for them to play with. They are handled carefully and professionally , my cat always comes back in excellent condition.

This is the first time I have ever left my dog's. I was not sure at first has one of my dogs it very unpredictable but they was amazing with both of them.when I picked them up both of them had been bathed and was very clean. I would definitely be using them again and I do recommend them for anybody that is unsure about leaving your pet. Thank you again

I wouldn't go anywhere else my spaniel is challenging and after speaking to staff I felt so at ease going on my holiday.
Going to get them today there was no glazed eyes as they have had previously there behaviour is remarkable and they are very tired Excellent service would definitely recommend.

Debs and Mitchell at Hartley Wood Kennels looked after Oscar my cocker / springer spaniel superbly this August. This included taking Oscar to the vets when required and keeping me fully informed, giving me full confidence and assurance. I would not hesitate recommending Hartley Wood Kennels.
Great set up, spacious kennels and staff that care. Would recommend

First experience of putting my rescue dog in kennels but we used to use Hartley wood many years ago for our family dogs.  Was a bit worried about him in case he totally shut down. However, after initially being told he was a bit worried, he settled in ok and, when I picked him up he was pretty relaxed and happy.
Friendly staff and dog returned in good health. Will use again.
